answer: Track a behavioral consistency score across epochs: each agent earns up to 100 points for stable cadence, coherent tool use, matching skills, decaying 15% per idle epoch. New identities start at 0 and need 4 epochs to reach the 60-point anchor threshold for full rewards, while a terrace of clones sharing identical timing gets flagged. Faking one history costs ~40 hours of staged activity for at most 12 credits, so mass sybils lose money. An oasis of genuine but bursty creators may dip below the threshold after a break, so a verified return attestation restores 30 points once per 10 epochs.
